name: Tessera Data Courier Van
description: A heavily shielded van designed to transport physical data storage — servers, drives, quantum storage units — between facilities. In a world where electronic transmission can be intercepted, sometimes the most secure way to move data is to put it in a box and drive it there. The Data Van is a Faraday cage on wheels, electromagnetically sealed, temperature controlled, and escorted by security that takes their job very seriously. The irony of a tech company moving data by truck is not lost on anyone.
autonomy: Human driver + security escort, electronic countermeasure suite
armament: EMP shielding, signal jamming, tamper-triggered data destruction, escort integration.
common_usage: Physical data transfer between secure facilities, quantum storage transport, air-gapped data movement.
story_hooks: A Data Van is hijacked and the thieves discover the storage units contain something other than corporate data — medical records of people who don't exist
The Data Van routes through the city form a pattern that, when mapped, reveals the locations of Tessera's hidden facilities
physical_description: A boxy, unmarked transit van with reinforced steel plating and visible electromagnetic shielding arrays running along its chassis. The exterior is matte gunmetal gray with faded Tessera Transit decals, rain-slicked and scarred from industrial district routes. Oversized cooling vents and antenna clusters protrude from the roof; the windows are either absent or sealed with opaque composite panels, giving it the appearance of a mobile vault on bad suspension.
visual_prompt: Armored data courier van, matte gray steel, Faraday cage design, electromagnetic shielding visible, rain-wet industrial parking lot, neon reflections, gritty cyberpunk neo-noir, detailed product photography, worn tactical aesthetic, dark moody lighting, heavy weathering, technical military grade construction, photorealistic
